cues: Verbs like give, send, offer, teach, tell, show and lend take two objects, a person and a thing, so they have two passives.
They gave me a prize: I was given a prize, which English prefers, or a prize was given to me.
He taught the boys English: the boys were taught English.
And buy, make, get and cook take for: a watch was bought for his sister.
